findings.element: Shopify stores card 'Ready' state + Sync block Enable (Overview, State 1 after setup)
findings.finding: Once the last setup step is done the store card says 'Ready' and its step list ends, while sync is still Disabled and the only pointer to Enable (the connect-first alert's 'After that, click Enable') disappeared when the first store was connected.
findings.user_impact: Users read 'Ready' as finished and leave without enabling sync, which is the KF-2 'I thought I was done' drop-off: no stock is ever sent.
findings.suggested_fix: While sync is Disabled, show a last step on the Ready card such as 'Click Enable in Sync to start sending stock changes'. Or keep the alert visible, now pointing at Enable, until sync is enabled.

evidence.action: State 1: Connect store → My ceramic plates → Choose location → Save → Open Settings
evidence.observed: Info alert is gone after connect; card reads 'My ceramic plates (Shopify) · Ready · Location: Warehouse in California · Mappings 4/5 · 1 item needs mapping · Map products'. The middle column still shows 'State: Disabled · Enable', and nothing on the card or page says Enable is still required.

findings.element: Update Shopify qty dialog on the comparison page (row and bulk)
findings.finding: The dialog tells the user 'If the stock changed since then, click Compare now first.' But the comparison page has no Compare now control. It is only on the Stock check list and the Overview block.
findings.user_impact: A user who wants to re-check must cancel, find 'All comparisons', run Compare now there, then find and reopen the new comparison, or else send a possibly stale difference.
findings.suggested_fix: Put a Compare now button for this store on the comparison page, or in the dialog itself.

evidence.action: State 2: Stock check block → Review differences → row 'Ceramic plate 24cm' → Update Shopify qty
evidence.observed: Dialog: 'Synder will send +8 … If the stock changed since then, click Compare now first.' Page text: 'All comparisons · My ceramic plates · Finished · Unresolved only · Compared on Oct 2, 2026 02:30 …'. There is no Compare now on the page.

findings.element: Overview Stock check block, State 3 (one nightly check failed)
findings.finding: The block shows the failure notice for My good flowers and, under it, the all-clear 'Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify.' But one store was not compared at all.
findings.user_impact: A user scanning the block reads the green all-clear and does not run Compare now, so differences in the uncompared store stay unseen.
findings.suggested_fix: While a store's last check has failed, limit the success line to the stores that were compared (e.g. 'My ceramic plates: stock is the same'), or hide it.

evidence.action: Switch to State 3 and read the Overview Stock check block
evidence.observed: 'error The last check of My good flowers failed (Oct 2, 2026 02:30), so its stock wasn't compared. Compare now · check_circle Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify.' Both are shown together.

findings.element: Activity tab · Held row (Reason 'Item not matched', Actions '–')
findings.finding: The Held row names the reason but has no action leading to the fix. Retry only replies 'Nothing was sent: fix the reason first.', so from Activity the user loops between Retry and a dead end.
findings.user_impact: Users who start from the Held count can't tell where to fix 'Item not matched' and retry with no effect, so the change stays unsent.
findings.suggested_fix: On Held rows whose reason is a missing mapping, add a 'Map item' action that opens the Mappings tab filtered to that store and product.

evidence.action: State 2: Overview Held count → Activity filtered Held → Retry 1 held
evidence.observed: Row 'Bill #1045 · Plate seconds (B-grade) · +12 · Held · Item not matched · –'. Retry gives the toast 'Nothing was sent: fix the reason first.' The row has no link or action to Mappings.

gaps: Sync Enable before any store is Ready (State 1, no store connected or store in Setup needed): Enable is recorded as disabled=false, but the result of clicking it then was never recorded, so it is unknown whether the user gets a block, a toast, or a silent no-op
Review differences when more than one store has differences: only the single-store case was exercised, so it is unknown which comparison opens
View rows on a comparison with 0 differences: never opened, so the empty comparison page state is unverified
Failed Activity events and the Failed Retry path: no sample data (prototype limitation)
Run now: only toasts '0 new changes', so the effect on Activity counts and Last sync was not observable
